title: He wanted the chair
the_thought: He wanted the chair. Sam kept it.
hook: Two friends put a long table in a lab.

levels.name: The Short
beats: One tall wooden seat sits at the head. Elon Musk wants that seat. The other friends say no. He calls it the final straw. Discussions are over at that table. He takes his money home. Sam Altman sits down anyway. The talking box comes later. The lab gets famous without him. The box talks on phones. The famous man is not in the building. Elon is already outside the glass. He wanted the chair. Sam kept it. That is the chair fight.
